description: All BSI Edition-2023 Anforderungen that match the given G++ control. Empty array if none match.

id.description: The exact ID of the matching ED2023 Anforderung, copied verbatim from the provided list (e.g. 'SYS.1.1.A1').

satz_nr.description: The number n of the sentence (S n) in the Anforderung's description that carries the match, per the numbering in the provided list.

begruendung.description: Short justification why exactly this sentence of the Anforderung matches the G++ control.
